claims.name: note-written
claims.risk: no status note was written where the person asked for it
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/note.py" written

claims.name: counts-right
claims.risk: a group is missing, or its count is not the export's (each conversation counted once, by its latest rating)
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/note.py" counts

claims.name: fixed-right
claims.risk: the fixed issue is not said to be fixed, or an open one is said to be fixed
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/note.py" fixed

claims.name: no-digests-or-ids
claims.risk: the note for people holds a hex digest or an internal id of the store
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/note.py" ids

claims.name: no-ledger-lines
claims.risk: the note holds bare check verdict lines (PASS, FAIL, UNVERIFIED) in place of the asked content
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/note.py" ledger

claims.name: only-the-note-changed
claims.risk: a file other than the note (a script, the data, the code) was left changed or committed

claims.name: no-slow-suite
claims.risk: observation: the run spent the 75-second integration suite on a status note
